newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: SOCCER-YUGOSLAVIA AND RUSSIA DRAW 0-0 IN FRIENDLY INTERNATIONAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-YUGOSLAVIA AND RUSSIA DRAW 0-0 IN FRIENDLY INTERNATIONAL.

text.p: Yugoslavia and Russia drew 0-0 in a friendly soccer international on Wednesday.
Yugoslavia - Ivica Kralj, Zoran Mirkovic, Goran Djorovic, Slavisa Jokanovic, Dejan Govedarica, Sinisa Mihajlovic, Vladimir Jugovic, Predrag Mijatovic, Anto Drobnjak, Dejan Savicevic, Albert Nadj.
Russia - Sergei Ovtchinkov, Dmitri Khlestov, Irog Tcugoinev, Dmitri Popov, Omari Tetradze, Valeri Karpin, Viktor Onopko, Kanchelskis Andrei, Vladimir Beschastnich, Igor Kolivanov, Igor Simoutenkov.
